estimand.parameter: Mean score at or above the cutoff minus mean score below the cutoff
estimand.estimator: Difference between the two independent-group sample means
estimand.standard_interval: Welch t interval using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

mri_grouping.source: Pooled median in the Phase 2 status_and_mri sample
mri_grouping.comparison_order: At or above cutoff minus below cutoff
mri_grouping.ties: Include values equal to the cutoff in the at-or-above group
mri_grouping.bootstrap_rule: Keep the cutoff fixed across bootstrap draws

bootstrap.generator: Python random.Random, Mersenne Twister, using choices with equal weights
bootstrap.draw_rule: Resample complete participant rows with replacement separately within the two MRI groups, preserving each group's observed size.
bootstrap.draw_order: Within each replicate, draw the at-or-above-cutoff group first, then the below-cutoff group, using one random stream.
bootstrap.row_order: Original eligible CSV order within each group, identified by the participant-table hash
bootstrap.unit: One complete participant row, preserving that person's UDS and MRI values together
bootstrap.cutoff: Keep the cutoff fixed across bootstrap draws
bootstrap.standard_error: Sample standard deviation of the bootstrap mean differences, denominator B - 1
bootstrap.exact_empirical_standard_error: sqrt(v_higher / n_higher + v_lower / n_lower), where each empirical variance v uses denominator n
bootstrap.percentile_interval: Percentile interval with linear interpolation at the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles

multiplicity.adjustment: Holm adjustment across the two planned tests
multiplicity.reporting: Report the test statistic, degrees of freedom, raw p-value and Holm-adjusted p-value
multiplicity.status: Pending the supplementary thickness-by-status test in Step 6. Calculate Holm adjustment once both planned raw p-values are available.

interpretation.effect: Higher MRI group's mean score minus lower MRI group's mean score, in correct animal names in 60 seconds
interpretation.standard_error: Estimated spread of the mean difference over repeated independent samples with the same two group sizes
interpretation.mean_offset: The empirical-bootstrap expectation of a difference of arithmetic means equals the observed difference. The reported small offset reflects finite-replicate Monte Carlo variation.
interpretation.comparison: Compare the bootstrap percentile interval with the Welch interval
interpretation.confidence_interval: Under repeated sampling with the stated assumptions, a nominal 95% procedure covers the target population parameter in about 95% of repeated samples.
interpretation.generalization: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.
interpretation.scope: Unadjusted exploratory comparison, conditional on the fixed cutoff and observed group sizes; age, sex and education are addressed in Phase 4.
interpretation.limits: Bootstrap approximations use the observed within-group empirical distributions. Agreement with Welch does not establish population coverage or practical equivalence.
interpretation.inference: This step estimates uncertainty in the contrast. Its resampling distribution is centered near the observed effect and is not a null distribution for calculating a new p-value.
